title.rendered: Coastal Friends Mangalore Felicitates Essam Mansoor on Qatar U19 Selection

content.rendered:
Coastal Friends Mangalore proudly felicitated young cricketing talent Essam Mansoor in recognition of his outstanding achievements and his selection to the Qatar U19 National Squad.

Essam’s remarkable journey in cricket, marked by dedication, discipline, hard work and passion, has earned him the prestigious opportunity to represent Qatar at the Under-19 international level. His achievement is a matter of immense pride not only for his family but also for the wider Mangalorean community across the globe.

At a young age, Essam has already demonstrated great promise in cricket, making his selection to the Qatar U19 National Squad a significant milestone in his sporting journey. His success serves as an inspiration to aspiring young cricketers and highlights the importance of perseverance, commitment and consistent support from family and the community.

Behind every young athlete’s success is a family that provides encouragement, sacrifices and unwavering support. Coastal Friends Mangalore proudly acknowledges the contribution of Essam’s parents, Mansoor Hasanabba Hentar and Razia Sulaiman Salmar, whose support has played an important role in his journey.

During the felicitation, CFM Former President Shareef Abbas Valal, Screening Committee Members Sirajuddin Parladka, Saleem Abbas, Founding Member Saif Sulthan Sayed, Naushad MK, Tahir Salmara, Munna Kammaradi and Sameer Seeco were present and extended their heartfelt congratulations and blessings to Essam and his family.

Coastal Friends Mangalore congratulates Essam Mansoor and his proud parents on this remarkable achievement and wishes him continued success in his cricketing career. We hope his journey will lead him to greater heights and inspire many more young talents from our community to pursue their dreams in sports.

May Essam continue to shine on the international cricket stage and keep the Mangalorean flag flying high!

title.rendered: Coastal Friends Mangalore Elects New Leadership Team for 2026–2027 at Annual General Meeting

content.rendered:
Coastal Friends Mangalore (Regd.) successfully conducted its Annual General Meeting (AGM) at the Bombay Lucky Restaurant Hall under the chairmanship of the outgoing President, Mr. Shareef Abbas Valal. The meeting witnessed active participation from members and marked the election of the organization’s new leadership team for the 2026–2027 term.

The AGM commenced with the recitation of the Holy Qur’an by Mueen. The Annual Report was presented by the General Secretary, Mr. Shoukath Ali, while Joint Secretary Mr. Junaid Bantwal submitted the annual report on the organization’s Medical Bed Service. Treasurer Mr. Imtiyaz S.M. presented the audited financial statement for the year. Following detailed discussions, all reports were unanimously approved by the members.

Addressing the gathering, outgoing President Mr. Shareef Abbas Valal highlighted the organization’s achievements over the past year and shared his vision for its continued growth. Honorary President Mr. Asif Sooralpady also addressed the members, appreciating the collective efforts that have strengthened Coastal Friends Mangalore’s commitment to community service.

The election process was conducted under the supervision of Mr. Saleem Abbas Valal, Mr. Asif Sooralpady, and Mr. Mustafa Dammale, ensuring a smooth and transparent selection process.

Following the election, the newly elected President Mr. Shameer Lucky Star expressed his sincere gratitude to all members for the confidence and trust they had placed in the new leadership. He reaffirmed the committee’s commitment to strengthening Coastal Friends Mangalore’s social service initiatives, promoting unity among members, and expanding the organization’s impact through meaningful community welfare, cultural, educational, and youth development activities.

The proceedings were compered by Munna Kamaradi, and the meeting concluded with a Dua, followed by a fellowship dinner attended by all members.

A New Chapter Begins

Coastal Friends Mangalore extends its heartfelt congratulations to the newly elected President, office bearers, Executive Committee, Screening Committee, Advisory Committee, and all Wing members. Their election reflects the trust and confidence of the members and marks the beginning of a new chapter dedicated to service, unity, integrity, and excellence.

May the 2026–2027 leadership team continue to uphold the organization’s vision, inspire positive change, and create a lasting legacy through impactful community service and meaningful initiatives.

title.rendered: CFM Barish Trophy Season 1 – 2025 Concludes with Grand Success

content.rendered:
The Coastal Friends Mangalore (CFM) community successfully organized a unique and vibrant cricket tournament — by friends, for friends, and managed by friends — under the banner of CFM Barish Trophy Season 1 – 2025. The tournament was held at the Uppala Ground, Kasaragod, amidst great enthusiasm, energy, and celebration held on 01 Aug 2025

This colorful cricket carnival featured five teams formed by CFM members, all competing for the prestigious Barish Trophy:

  1. Royal Hunters – Owner: Siraj Parladka
  2. CFM Heroes – Owner: Salam Sammi
  3. CFM Lagaan – Owner: Shafeek Valal
  4. Arafa Silvers – Owner: Shafeek Arafa
  5. FCC Strikers – Owner: Munna Kammaradi

More than just a sporting event, the tournament stood as a true celebration of friendship, teamwork, coordination, and sportsmanship. Every match delivered thrilling moments, with excitement building steadily as the competition advanced toward the finals.

Royal Hunters dominated the league stage and secured a direct entry into the final by topping the points table. Meanwhile, FCC Strikers earned their spot in the final after an impressive semi-final victory over CFM Heroes.

The grand final, which continued with great enthusiasm until 2:00 AM, witnessed an electrifying contest. Displaying dominant yet disciplined gameplay, Royal Hunters emerged victorious, defeating FCC Strikers to claim their maiden CFM Barish Trophy title.

The successful conclusion of CFM Barish Trophy Season 1 – 2025 marked a memorable milestone for Coastal Friends Mangalore. Heartfelt congratulations to the champions Royal Hunters, all participating teams, organizers, and members who contributed to making this inaugural season a well-organized and unforgettable success.

title.rendered: Coastal Friends Mangalore Joins Anti-Drug Awareness Rally

content.rendered:
As part of the observance of International Day Against Drug Abuse – 2025, an awareness rally and public program were organized in collaboration with the Mangalore City Police, National Service Scheme (NSS) unit, and the Nitte Institute of Professional Education.

Office bearers and members of Coastal Friends Mangalore (R) actively participated in the rally, expressing strong support for the Mangalore Police’s fight against drug abuse and promoting public awareness and civic responsibility in the battle against narcotics.

This initiative served as a reminder that drug abuse not only destroys individuals and families but also weakens the foundation of our society. Events like these help reinforce the importance of prevention, early education, and united action to build a healthier, drug-free future for the next generation.

title.rendered: Siraj Parladka’s Birthday Marked with Acts of Kindness by Coastal Friends Mangalore

content.rendered:
On the occasion of the birthday of Mr. Siraj Parladka, the founder of Coastal Friends Mangalore (R), a heartfelt charitable initiative was carried out in collaboration with M. Friends Karunya Seva at Wenlock District Hospital, Mangalore. Special meals were distributed to nearly 400 patients and their family members, spreading compassion and care.

Following this, a visit was made to the Yateem Khana (Orphanage) in Pandeshwar, where pizza and beverages were served to 50 orphaned girls. The event was marked by comforting the sick and sharing love with the children, embodying the values of empathy and community service.

Prayers were also offered for Siraj Parladka’s well-being, success in this life and the Hereafter.

In attendance at the event were CFM President Shareef Abbas Walal, Vice President Sajid Odeyar, Safwan Khan, Shoukath Ali, Munn Kammaradi, Iqbal Parliya, Naufal Krishnapura, Naushad M.K, Aman Nelyadi, Dawood Vision, Safwan Karaya, and several others.

title.rendered: Star of the Coastal – 2024 Awardees Honored at JAK Cricket Carnival

content.rendered:
Coastal Friends Mangalore proudly recognized five outstanding individuals with the ‘Star of the Coastal – 2024’ awards during the JAK Cricket Carnival – Season 5, held at Sahyadri College Ground, Adyar, Mangalore. This prestigious recognition is presented annually to Coastal Friends members in appreciation of their remarkable efforts and community spirit.

These awards were presented to acknowledge the exceptional performance, dedication, and ultimate contribution of members who have consistently inspired the community through their positive actions and unwavering commitment.

🏅 Awardees:

  • Mr. Faizel Rehman – Attractive of the Coastal
  • Mr. Afthab Basthikar – Supportive of the Coastal
  • Mr. Rilwan Husain – Active of the Coastal
  • Mr. Shoukath Ali – Caring of the Coastal
  • Mr. Junaid Bantwal – Spirit of the Coastal

These remarkable individuals were honored in the gracious presence of Mr. Shareef Abbas, President of Coastal Friends Mangalore; Mr. Siraj Parladka, Founder of Coastal Friends; Mr. Ansif, CEO of Expertise Company; Mr. Arjun Bandarkar, President of Save Life Charitable Trust; and Mr. Haneef Haji Golthamajal, President of Hidayah Foundation, along with many other respected community leaders and esteemed guests.

“Together, let’s continue to celebrate the power of community, kindness, and selfless service. These individuals remind us of the positive impact we can make and inspire us all to strive for excellence.”

This recognition is part of Coastal Friends’ ongoing mission to encourage meaningful contributions and to celebrate those who embody the values of unity, compassion, and leadership in society.

title.rendered: Jak Cricket Carnival – Season 5 | Jersey and Trophy Launch Ceremony

content.rendered:
The much-anticipated Jersey and Trophy Launch Ceremony for Jak Cricket Carnival – Season 5 was held at Fiza by Nexus Mall, Mangalore on 13th January 2025, marking an exciting milestone in the build-up to the highly awaited tournament. Coastal Friends Mangalore proudly hosted this exclusive event, which serves as a prelude to the grand tournament.

Tournament Dates:
The cricket matches will take place on 18th & 19th January 2025 at Sahyadri College Ground, Adyar, Mangalore.

Event Highlights:
The launch ceremony was a lively and festive occasion, where the official jerseys for each team were unveiled, alongside the tournament trophy. The members were thrilled to witness the culmination of months of planning as the new season of the Jak Cricket Carnival started to take shape.

Teams and Owners:
The tournament features four dynamic teams, each backed by passionate team owners:

A1 Royal Club – Owned by Riyaz A1
CFM Heroes – Owned by Salam Sammi
Royal Hunters – Owned by Siraj Parladka
JakXten – Co-owned by Shabeer Jak and Dawood Xten
Upcoming Tournament Matches:
The much-anticipated tournament matches are scheduled for 18th & 19th January 2025. These exciting games promise to be a true showcase of skill, teamwork, and sportsmanship as the four teams compete for the trophy at the Sahyadri College Ground.

Celebrating Friendship and Sportsmanship:
Jak Cricket Carnival – Season 5 isn’t just about cricket; it’s about building camaraderie and celebrating the bond of friendship among Coastal Friends Mangalore members. The tournament serves as a platform for members to connect, compete, and enjoy the spirit of togetherness that defines the community.

Let’s Celebrate Together:
As the tournament draws near, Coastal Friends Mangalore is excited for another season of unforgettable moments, thrilling cricket action, and, most importantly, the spirit of unity. Here’s to a successful season filled with fun, excitement, and great memories!

Best of Luck to All Teams in Season 5!

title.rendered: Santwanada Sanchara 2.0 – A Day with Orphans

content.rendered:
Coastal Friends Mangalore successfully conducted the second edition of “Santwanada Sanchara 2.0 – A Day with Orphans” on December 14, 2024. The event, aimed at bringing joy and hope to orphaned children, was inaugurated by Mr. Anupam Agrawal, Police Commissioner of Mangalore, at BMS Hotel.

Watch Video

A total of 85 children, picked up from their homes and dropped back after the event, participated in this special day. Prior to the start of the event, Coastal Friends distributed uniforms to all participating children, ensuring they felt special and part of the day’s festivities. The event unfolded as follows:

  1. Breakfast and Inauguration: The day began with a hearty breakfast, followed by the formal inauguration of the event.
  2. Pilikula Zoo and Exhibition: The children were taken to Pilikula, where they enjoyed a visit to the zoo and participated in an exhibition, experiencing nature and wildlife.
  3. Lunch at Umaiya Garden, Kutthar: The children then enjoyed a delicious lunch at Umaiya Garden, Kutthar, providing a relaxing break during their exciting day.
  4. Cultural Activities: Various cultural activities were held, showcasing the talents of the children and offering them an opportunity to express themselves.
  5. Competitions: Engaging competitions were organized, providing fun and fostering healthy competition among the children.
  6. Drawing Activities: The children participated in creative drawing activities, allowing them to explore their artistic side.
  7. Magic Show: A magical performance added excitement and wonder to the day, leaving the children amazed and delighted.
  8. Sports and Swimming: The children also enjoyed engaging in sports and swimming activities, offering them a chance to be active and have fun.
  9. Fun Stalls: The event featured small stalls reminiscent of childhood days, such as popcorn stalls and other treats, creating a nostalgic atmosphere for everyone.

Dancing and Singing:

Coastal Friends members joined the children in dancing, singing, and performing memory games, creating a joyful and energetic atmosphere. Volunteers made every effort to fulfill the children’s wishes and ensure they enjoyed themselves to the fullest. The children also enjoyed performing various mimicry acts, adding to the fun of the day.

Coastal Friends Mangalore (R) Website launch

A significant highlight of the day was the launch of the new Coastal Friends website, which was proudly unveiled by the children. In the presence of esteemed guests, the children had the honor of launching the website, symbolizing their importance in the initiative and making them an integral part of the celebration. The website launch added an extra layer of excitement to the day and was a proud moment for all involved.

Coastal Friends Bravery Award:

During the conclusion program, Master Abdul Khader Sawad, son of Zainudeen, Sunlight KC Road, was presented with the Coastal Friends Bravery Award. He was honored for his remarkable presence of mind and quick action, which served as an inspiration to all. His bravery demonstrated courage and responsibility beyond his years, and he truly deserves to be celebrated for his exemplary act.

Conclusion Program: The day concluded with a closing program, marking the end of a memorable experience for all participants. Guests who attended the conclusion program expressed their appreciation for the initiative, proudly acknowledging the positive impact it had on the children. They were deeply moved by the love and care shown by Coastal Friends and were proud of the initiative.

At the conclusion program, the event was graced by several esteemed guests who played a significant role in making it a grand success. The list of dignitaries included Nasir Lucky Star (Waqf Chairman DK, Govt of Karnataka), Hasir Marine (Partner, Marine), Raheem Expertise (Director of Expertise), Arjun Bhandarkar (President of Save Life Charitable Trust), Saiduddin (Vice President of Talent Research Foundation), Mahammad Ali Kammaradi (Ex-member, Food Commission, Govt of Karnataka), Shahul Hameed KK (President of Minority Cell, DK Congress), Shabeer Siddakatte (General Secretary of Minority, DK Congress), Latheef Gurupura (MD of Ani Trading), Siraj Parladka (Founder of Coastal Friends Mangalore), and Shareef Abbas Valal (President of Coastal Friends Mangalore). Their presence added immense value to the event, and their support was greatly appreciated by the entire Coastal Friends team.

Throughout the day, Coastal Friends Mangalore members treated the children with love, care, and attention, as though they were their own. The children were embraced with warmth and affection, enjoying every moment alongside the volunteers. The bond between the children and the volunteers grew stronger, filled with smiles, laughter, and lasting memories.

As a token of appreciation, Rs. 10,000 worth hampers were given to each child who participated, ensuring they left with a special gift.

The event was also supported by a dedicated medical team and comprehensive transportation facilities, ensuring the safety and well-being of all participants.

In addition, Coastal Friends Mangalore made a generous contribution to the community by donating 50 wheelchairs to individuals in need, ensuring that those who required mobility support could benefit from the donation.

The positive message of the event, as conveyed by Coastal Friends Founder Mr. Siraj Parladka, was powerful: “They are not orphans; they are our special guests.” This message reflected the core belief that these children are not to be pitied, but celebrated as valuable members of the community.

The event was proudly called “A Blessed Day with Our Kids – Happiest Moments of Our Life”, encapsulating the joy, love, and unforgettable memories created throughout the day.

Coastal Friends Mangalore extends its heartfelt gratitude to all those who supported and contributed to the success of this event. Special thanks to the Police team, media, the public, guests, resort officials, Pilikula officials, and public personalities who joined our poster campaign. We are also thankful to the actors, politicians, social media influencers, and most importantly, the parents of the children, for their support and trust. Their presence and involvement helped make this event a truly memorable and impactful experience.

Coastal Friends Mangalore continues its mission of spreading hope, joy, and support to those in need, reaffirming its commitment to making a difference in the lives of children and the community.
